claims.exact_statement: For every finite actual-power-law endotactic diagram on the positive orthant, every measurable coefficient path with one common 0<kappa<=k_e(t)<=K envelope, and every positive stoichiometric class P, the N33 candidate asserts a common compact convex positive forward-invariant absorber K_P subset P, chosen before x0 and the rate path; each positive trajectory is global and eventually enters K_P. The bound epsilon_P is class-dependent, while entry time may depend on x0 but not the rate path.
assumptions: Endotacticity uses only essential reactions for each projection, and maximal essential sources point toward decreasing projection.
Finite fixed diagram; real or negative source exponents allowed only on the positive orthant.
Measurable Caratheodory rates with a uniform positive lower and finite upper bound.
claims.novelty_boundary: Would extend two-species endotactic variable-rate permanence to arbitrary finite dimension and all endotactic diagrams, beyond strongly endotactic all-dimensional theorems. The full candidate proof manuscript is absent from the pinned Astra tree, and priority/external correctness are unresolved.
claims.costs: No useful bound is supplied for affine family size, offsets, class scale h_P, precision, or entry time. Coefficients and class information must be acquired; a real metabolic model also needs verified kinetic orders and rate envelopes.
claims.falsifier: An independently certified exact model satisfying all assumptions with a trajectory that fails global existence/positivity or fails eventual entry into a supplied explicit K_P. No explicit K_P is currently supplied for a metabolic system.
claims.next_gate: Recover the exact P package and obtain independent line-by-line review of affine activity, weighted drift, and the nonnested scale chain.

claims.exact_statement: Conditional on the N33 mechanism, a finite family of all-endotactic modes with identical stoichiometric subspace S and a common positive bounded envelope has a shared compact classwise absorber under arbitrary measurable mode selection; convex mixtures preserve this when their weights are nonnegative and sum to one.
assumptions: Every selected mode spans the same S.
Selected-mode reaction coefficients are uniformly bounded above and away from zero.
Finite set of modes, so the union source and reaction-vector comparison set remains finite.
claims.novelty_boundary: N33 card attributes this consequence to the candidate; current proof is a direct finite-union extension of the weighted drift. It does not require the union diagram to be endotactic.
claims.costs: Finite mode diagrams and rate envelopes are supplied/acquired; no complexity bound for the shared affine construction.
claims.falsifier: A finite same-span mode family satisfying all assumptions whose trajectory under measurable switching exits an explicit candidate common absorber after entry.
claims.next_gate: Independent review of the simultaneous union tolerance set D and the common lower drift across modes.

claims.exact_statement: Conditional extension: a finite undirected graph of equal-volume compartments with all-endotactic local modes sharing one local stoichiometric span, plus positive bounded reversible linear exchange for each species, forms a finite product network that is all-endotactic with mode-independent total span. The common-span result therefore yields classwise permanence of the joint positive state.
assumptions: Finite compartment graph and finite local mode sets.
Local all-endotactic networks have a common span across modes.
Exchange is reversible along undirected edges and each selected exchange coefficient has a positive lower and finite upper bound.
No continuum PDE or irreversible transport is included.
claims.novelty_boundary: A finite-product-network consequence under explicit common-span and positive reversible transport assumptions; related spatial/compartment work exists, and no priority claim is made. Astra N54 is source-derived and conditional on N33.
claims.costs: Requires measured compartment-specific reaction/transport rates, kinetic exponents, finite graph, and class invariants; no practical epsilon_P or construction algorithm is supplied.
claims.falsifier: An exact finite model satisfying these premises whose joint class has a positive trajectory not eventually confined to any compact subset of the positive orthant.
claims.next_gate: Check against the full R09 spatial proof and a named measured compartment model before advertising the result as an application.

claims.exact_statement: If the common-span premise is removed, modes A: A<->2A and B: B<->2B (unit coefficients) are individually all-endotactic, but mode A selected forever leaves B fixed. Since the union span is R^2, no one compact positive absorber can absorb every initial state in the union stoichiometric class across all allowed schedules.
assumptions: Mode selector may choose either mode indefinitely.
The candidate class for switching is the positive class associated with the span generated by the union of mode reaction vectors.
claims.novelty_boundary: Elementary obstruction to extending the classwise switching statement to different mode spans; it does not challenge single-mode N33 permanence.
claims.costs: No computational or data cost; exact two-dimensional logistic equations.
claims.falsifier: The algebraic fact that compact subsets of R^2_{>0} have positive minimum B or the exact constant-B solution under mode A.
claims.next_gate: Keep classwise switching conclusions restricted to common spans or provide a different joint invariant that prevents the frozen-coordinate obstruction.

claims.exact_statement: For A<->2A with k_+(t)=1 and k_-(t)=exp(-t), the exact positive solution x(t)=exp(t)/(t+1/x(0)) diverges, so an upper rate bound without a uniform positive lower bound cannot ensure a compact absorber.
assumptions: The reverse rate is allowed to approach zero over time.
The positive lower-bound premise is removed.
claims.novelty_boundary: Shows why the uniform lower coefficient bound is load-bearing even for a two-reaction weakly reversible diagram.
claims.costs: No computational or data cost; exact reciprocal transformation.
claims.falsifier: Direct substitution verifies the solution and its divergence.
claims.next_gate: Do not apply the candidate to reaction shutdown or vanishing enzyme/transporter activity unless those mechanisms are represented differently and the lower bound is re-established.
